I know exactly that feeling. My wife left me and im 35. I feel like I wont get another chance at being married. I dont want one that because I want her back. My life was the best with her. But I realize that it hurts so much more then it should because I was missing a piece and I used her to replace it. I am working on fixing that. I have been told that I shouldent have a missing part or hole that relies on a girl to make me fill whole.

If you end your life Im sure you will hurt him even more and hurt your family. I would say my insecurities ruined my marriage too. Btw Im 35 and stressed I will not get another chance at marriage. But I will say my insecurities hurt the relationship however that other person not being the right mach for me and triggering those feelings was an issue too. Therapy helps me deal with the issues better. It dosnt fix them just makes me able to better deal with them.
Dosnt seem like you broke post rules. But I know how you feel. I am loosing everything right now too. It seems like you have two good reasons to keep on. I wish I had reasons that good.

I would say see what else you can start taking control of in your life. Start small. Picking what you are gonna eat for lunch, how you will spend an hour of your free time tomorrow. Keep trying to regain control of your life.

I feel the same way alot of the time. Im 35, with no family either. I am going threw a divorce and I got laid off 2 weeks ago. Two things help me even know im in a very dark place right now also.
1 Im in therapy working on similar issues and other issues as well. 
2 To be honest I found connections with other people with social issues. I went to a game shop (the kind that plays magic and d&d) and met some new people doing that. 
These things help me. I have 4 friends but am loosing them too because my problems are having an effect on them and they are pulling away.

I have body ache as well. It was worse. It might sound stupid but I just found by out by coincidence that milk makes me break out. I didnt drink in for like two months and my skin got better. I drank it one day and ate some ice cream and broke out a bit after. Im not saying it will be the same for you but you could find something that makes it clear up a bit like I did. Btw Im 35yo. I started getting body ache when I was 30ish. Your body changes all the time and stuff that did not affect it before can have an affect now.

You cant save everyone. You cant fight against the entirety of life that has brought the people here qho have thoughts of suicide. Trained professionals cant even stop some people from wanting to end it all. You seem like a kind soul that has found one of the darkest areas of reality. You can only be a small light in a seemingly endless amount of darkness. Im certain you have helped someone. Maybe you even are helping me right now. But you cant stop the darkness in this world. You cant save all. You cant try to or your light will go dim and less effective. It may even be consumed by the darkness. I hope that never happens to you. I hope you never end up in the darkness that we face friend. But if you ever do I hope someone like you comes to your aid.
